title: feat(objectql, plugin-security): the ReadableIds leaf composes for a delegated (on-behalf-of) caller with the delegator intersection; ADR-0139 records O5 answered and D5.1 amended
body:
Fixes #25009

Engine card (b)(i) of the maintainer's ruling B on #24932 (comment 6303721609): the engine composes its `ReadableIds` leaf for a delegated (on-behalf-of) caller, scoped to the ADR-0090 D10 delegator intersection, instead of refusing it; the ADR-0139 revision rides this PR (O5 answered yes in the end-state form, D5.1 amended). Draft on purpose: the diff touches `docs/adr/**` (Tier H), so it waits for the maintainer's approval. The nested master chain is #25010 and remains open; the plugin-security switch of `controlled_by_parent` (its call sites, the id-list pre-scan's retirement, ADR-0055's text) is card (c), #24932, and remains open — none of it is touched here.

Clause-②: no (an engine-internal leaf, not a published accept set; the runtime read-scope change is the human floor's, decided by ruling 6303721609)

## What changed

**`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` (the ReadableIds leaf composition only).** `refuseUncomposableReadableIdsClasses` no longer reads the caller's context: the D5.1 refusal (`for a delegated (on-behalf-of) caller: the parent's read scope does not carry the delegator intersection …`) is gone, and the two remaining D5 classes (a parent an object-scoped read middleware narrows; a parent bound to another datasource) are refused by name exactly as before, same envelope, same text. `composeReadableIdsAtBoundary` asks `canReadObject` and `getReadFilter` with the delegated context as it stands (`onBehalfOf` intact) and composes what the security service answers. The engine derives no second intersection: it has one context, the delegated one, and the delegator's grants are the security service's to resolve. The method docblocks say so.

**`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts` — the one prerequisite without which the leaf cannot compose a delegated read correctly.** D5.1's own exit condition is "until the intersection reaches `getReadFilter`". Measured on `origin/main` (05b28c199, the merge base of this PR) before editing: `getReadFilter` answered the deny sentinel for every on-behalf-of context (the `[#2852]` block), so a composed leaf would have been `$in: []` for every delegated read — the very reason D5.1 refused. Nothing on `main` answers a delegated context the D10 intersection on the read-scope path (the engine middleware composes it inline into `ast.where` for `find`/`count`/`aggregate`, and the sharing middleware ANDs its own second call in a sibling plugin; neither is callable as a scope). So the WIP re-implements nothing that exists; each hunk is kept for this reason:

- `getReadFilter` (~5917): the on-behalf-of branch routes to `computeDelegatedReadFilter` instead of answering the deny sentinel. Fails CLOSED on every throw, with the deny sentinel by identity. Without this hunk the engine composes `$in: []` for every delegated read.
- `computeDelegatedReadFilter` (new, ~5996): the six layers the engine middleware chain ANDs into a delegated `find` of the object, in the middleware's own primitives — `computeRlsFilter` and `computeControlledByParentFilter` over the principal's sets with the delegated context as it stands, the same two over the delegator's sets with the context `resolveDelegatorContext` rebuilds (the middleware's D10 half), and plugin-sharing's `buildReadFilter` under each identity at its own depth (step 2.6's two depth stamps, from the same two evaluator calls). Closed doors are the chain's: a principal that resolves no set, a delegator who does not exist, a delegator who resolves no set, a sharing outage ⇒ the deny sentinel. The missing-delegator refusal keeps the D10 invariant sentence verbatim because `default-report-sink.test.ts` reads it.
- `resolveSharingReadFilter` (~5421): an optional `depth` parameter, so the agent leg is stamped the intersected depth (`intersectDelegatedScope` of the ceiling's declared depth and the delegator's effective one) and the delegator leg its own, as step 2.6 stamps them on a delegated `find`. Without it the agent leg would be stamped `getEffectiveScope` of the ceiling's sets — `own` for a silent ceiling — and a delegated read through the leaf would be narrower than the delegated direct read (parity pin red, no leak). Absent on every non-delegated call, which resolves the depth as before.
- The `getReadFilter` docblock gains the D10 paragraph; the `[#2852]` deny block and its comment are removed.

Not touched: `computeControlledByParentFilter`'s call sites, the id-list pre-scan, ADR-0055, any spec key, any consumer's `'delegated-caller'` probe routing.

**`docs/adr/0139-engine-internal-semi-join-leaf-readable-parent-ids.md` (Tier H).** The status paragraph records the amendment; D5 is retitled (two classes stay; the delegated caller composes) and D5.1 rewritten as the composition built here, naming the two halves and the six layers; D6 records O5 decided with the ruling's sentence quoted verbatim and the order it binds (delegated composition → nested chain → the plugin-security switch, which corrects ADR-0055's "cached within the request" sentence in its own edit); the "Leaves unchanged" line notes ADR-0055 §2 (b) stands until that switch; E2's execution-plan row notes the amendment beside its historical "three classes". ADR-0055 and ADR-0090 are not edited.

**Tests.** `packages/objectql/src/engine-readable-ids-composition.test.ts`: a new describe beside the existing leaf pins — each read verb asks both halves with the delegation link intact and hands the driver one call carrying the composed leaf (scope by reference, marked `policy`); a middleware-written leaf composes for a delegated caller; the closed doors under a delegated context (`canReadObject` false, the deny sentinel, a throw on either half ⇒ `$in: []`); D5.2 and D5.3 keep their refusal (code and status, no driver call, the service unasked); a control without the link. The old `D5 — a delegated (on-behalf-of) caller` refusal pin is replaced (it pinned the branch this PR deletes). `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/readable-ids-delegated-compose.test.ts` (new): the real stack — `ObjectQL` over better-sqlite3, the real `SecurityPlugin` with the real `SharingService`, the delegated context as `resolveAuthzContext` and `assembleExecutionContext` build it — with the two legs made to disagree on purpose (the ceiling admits parents by content and is silent on depth; the delegator's set is silent on rows, so their leg is the owner-match plus one share): a delegated read through the leaf serves exactly the children whose parent both legs admit (`c_both`, `c_shared`; not `c_caller_only`, not `c_del_only`), `find` and `count` agree, one statement touches the parent table (the subquery, no pre-scan), `getReadFilter`'s scope and the delegated direct read answer the same rows, and the closed doors stay closed (a delegator who does not exist ⇒ 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` at admission, `canReadObject` false, the sentinel by identity; a delegator the parent object does not admit ⇒ the leaf serves nothing; D5.2 ⇒ `INTERNAL_ERROR` / 500). Three plugin-security pins that asserted "a delegated context denies outright" are respelled for the case they now reach (a delegator who does not exist) in `controlled-by-parent-sharing.test.ts`, `rls-deny-sentinel-identity.test.ts`, `security-plugin.test.ts`; `default-report-sink.test.ts` and `start-logger-binding.test.ts` keep their assertions, their docblocks name the refusal a bare instance now reaches.

**Changeset** `.changeset/25009-readable-ids-delegated-compose.md`: `@objectstack/objectql` minor, `@objectstack/plugin-security` minor — a capability, not a defect repair, levelled as the earlier ADR-0139 composition cards were (`feat(objectql)` E2 and `feat(plugin-audit)` E5 both shipped as minor).

## The D5 fork question (measure and report)

No fork. The middleware-narrowed parent (D5.2) and the other-datasource parent (D5.3) keep their named 500 refusals under a delegated context too (pinned with `code` and `status` in both test files). Neither blocks "once for every shape" for the delegated class: they are properties of the parent object, orthogonal to who the caller is, and `controlled_by_parent`'s masters are ordinary objects on the same datasource with no object-scoped middleware. They keep the probe by ADR-0139 D5 as written.

## The direct (non-leaf) delegated read of the parent

`getReadFilter` is not on the engine middleware's path (the middleware composes its layers inline), so the ordinary door is unchanged by construction; measured anyway on the real stack: the delegated direct read of the parent answers `p_both`, `p_shared` — the delegator's rows the ceiling admits — and the control reads (the delegator alone; the ceiling's rule on a principal who owns the other rows) are pinned beside it.

## Verification (head `4c31b7cc9`, every heavy run through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, verdict read off its VERDICT line)

- Build of the dependency closure, `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/plugin-security...' --concurrency=2`: 19 tasks successful (9 cached), `VERDICT command-exit 0`, 73 s. The closure includes `@objectstack/objectql`, whose changed source the plugin-security suites read through the package's vitest alias to `src/` (so the real-stack pins read this checkout, not a dist).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test` (`vitest run --project local`): `Test Files 451 passed (451)`, `Tests 8511 passed (8511)`, 436 s, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security test`: `Test Files 200 passed (200)`, `Tests 4124 passed | 45 skipped (4169)`, 249 s, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security typecheck` exit 0 (tsc, the scripts project and `check:test-typecheck`, 0 errors held for plugin-security).
- The leaf consumers' integration suites, as a courtesy (their delegated-caller cases route to the probe before any leaf is written): `plugin-audit` `parent-record-read-leaf.integration` + `comment-parent-pair.integration` 34 passed; `service-storage` `attachment-read-leaf.integration` 10 passed.
- `test:repo` (the vitest `repo` project) not run locally: CI's `Test Core` runs it on the PR.

## Ablation (two behaviours changed, one leg each; `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation and restore proven on disk)

- **A — the engine's delegated refusal restored** (`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`, anchor `const parents = this.refuseUncomposableReadableIdsClasses(object, operation, sites);`, a throw of `readableIdsRefusalError` for an on-behalf-of context planted before it): `ok mutation landed: anchor 1 → 0, blob 2879fdae7f2d → 592ebdd1d394`. Under it: `engine-readable-ids-composition.test.ts` `4 failed | 23 passed` (the four delegated cases, including D5.2/D5.3 which met the planted refusal first); `readable-ids-delegated-compose.test.ts` `3 failed | 7 passed` (the delegated child read, the one-statement pin, the unadmitted-delegator leaf case). Restore: `ok restored: blob == HEAD (2879fdae7f2d) and git diff HEAD is empty`. The first attempt of this leg was refused by the tool before anything ran (the replacement contained the anchor line, so the anchor count did not drop); respelled and re-run.
- **B — `getReadFilter`'s delegated deny restored** (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts`, anchor `return await this.computeDelegatedReadFilter(object, context);` → `return RLS_DENY_FILTER;`): `ok mutation landed: anchor 1 → 0, blob caf66c649f18 → 9265a52c175c`. Under it: `readable-ids-delegated-compose.test.ts` `3 failed | 7 passed` (the delegated child read serves nothing, the parity pin, the one-statement pin). Restore: `ok restored: blob == HEAD (caf66c649f18) and git diff HEAD is empty`.
- Both legs ran against `src/` (objectql's own test imports `./engine.js`; the plugin-security suite aliases `@objectstack/objectql` to `src/index.ts` in its vitest config), so no dist rebuild was on the resolution path; `git status --porcelain` empty after each leg.

## Gates (derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, no paths, on this head; exit codes captured to a file before any pipe; reconciled with `--ran`)

`83 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 81 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED`. 80 of the 81 exit 0, including `check:adr-anchors`, `check:adr-links`, `check-adr-symbol-anchors` (2374 anchors resolve), `check:changeset`-family rows, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:where-matcher`, `check:objectql-double-limit`, `check:durability-log-level`, `check:swallow-census-controls`, `check:stack-collection-maps`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:pm-prior-rulings`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:type-check-debt`. NOT MEASURED locally, each a refusal of its own prerequisite, not a red: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3: reads every package's `dist/`, 55 packages unbuilt here; CI's `Build Core` builds the repo and runs it) and `pnpm check:i18n` (exit 3: the same full-closure prerequisite). `node scripts/check-engine-split-ratio.mjs --days 90` (the push/schedule `engine-split-metric.yml` job, not a PR gate) exit 2: refused on this shallow clone (oldest visible commit 2026-09-07 is inside the 90-day window); its `--self-test` row exit 0. The full farm is CI's; read the PR's check-runs.

## Acceptance notes

- The six consumers' up-front `'delegated-caller'` probe routing (`plugin-audit` `parent-record-read-gate.ts:451`, `service-storage` `attachment-access-hooks.ts:1020`, and the comment/reaction gates) is now a residue of the refusal this PR removes; ADR-0139 D5.1 as amended says it retires per consumer on its own card. Not changed here (a consumer switch is not this card's scope); carrier: none yet — noted, not filed.
- The `#24932` dev report's measured difference (2), a caller holding child read but no object-level read on the master, is card (c)'s / the ruling's second question; untouched here.
- `resolveDelegatorContext` leaves the delegator's `rlsMembership` bags unresolved (its own docblock); the delegator leg of `computeDelegatedReadFilter` inherits that fail-closed narrowing exactly as the middleware's D10 half does. Not a finding — parity with the middleware is the contract.
- The merge of `origin/main` (05b28c199, four commits since the branch base, one of them `#25008` in `security-plugin.ts` at a region far from these hunks) was clean; no generated artifact moved; the closure was rebuilt after it.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么。** 引擎的 `ReadableIds` 叶子(「对象 P 中当前调用者可读的 id 集」,ADR-0139)现在也为「代理调用者」(一个 agent/服务以某个用户的名义发起的读,on-behalf-of)组合,范围是 ADR-0090 D10 规定的交集:只看到「代理方自己能看到」且「被代理的用户也能看到」的行。此前引擎遇到这类调用直接拒绝(500)。为此 plugin-security 的 `getReadFilter` 在代理上下文下不再一律回答「全拒」,而是按引擎中间件对代理读所做的六层叠加(两方各自的行级安全与 controlled_by_parent 推导,再加两方各自身份下的共享可见性)回答同一个交集。ADR-0139 相应修订:O5 记为「是」(controlled_by_parent 将成为第七个消费者,按裁决的末态形式),D5.1 从「拒绝」改为「组合」。

**为什么改。** 这是维护者在 #24932 上的裁决 B 第 (b)(i) 步:先让引擎把叶子组合覆盖代理调用与嵌套主从链(#25010),再让 plugin-security 一次性把 controlled_by_parent 切到叶子,并退役主表 id 列表预扫描(那条预扫描在 HotCRM 规模下已实测 500)。没有这一步,代理读在叶子上只能得到空集,plugin-security 的切换无从谈起。

**风险与代价(含回滚)。** 行为变化只在两处:① 引擎不再拒绝代理调用者写出的叶子 —— 但今天没有任何消费者为代理调用者写叶子(六个消费者仍把它路由到有界探针),所以线上已发布面无行为变化;② 直接绑定 `getReadFilter` 的门(analytics 原生 SQL 路径)对代理上下文从「全拒」变为「交集」—— 方向是放宽到与 `/data` 直读一致的行集,实测与代理直读逐行一致,关门(被代理用户不存在、无对象级读权限、任一方无权限集、任一层解析失败)仍全部拒绝。真机测试:两包全量套件绿(objectql 8511、plugin-security 4124),两处消融各自把对应的 pin 打红后复原。回滚:revert 本 PR 即回到 D5.1「拒绝」的状态,无数据或 schema 变更;changeset 为 minor。

**席位意见。**

**你要做的。** 审阅 `docs/adr/0139` 的修订(O5 记为已答、D5.1 改为组合)并批准本 PR(Tier H);批准后由席位入队落地,#25010(嵌套主从链)随后在同区域串行进行。
